signature: SUBROUTINE DTGEX2( WANTQ, WANTZ, N, A, LDA, B, LDB, Q, LDQ, Z,

params.name: wantq
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the left transformation matrix Q; .FALSE.: do not update Q.

params.name: wantz
params.reference: .TRUE. : update the right transformation matrix Z; .FALSE.: do not update Z.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrices A and B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in the pair (A, B). On exit, the updated matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the matrix B in the pair (A, B). On exit, the updated matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTQ` = .TRUE., the orthogonal matrix Q. On exit, the updated matrix Q. Not referenced if `WANTQ` = .FALSE..

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$. If `WANTQ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$.

params.name: Z
params.reference: On entry, if `WANTZ` =.TRUE., the orthogonal matrix Z. On exit, the updated matrix Z. Not referenced if `WANTZ` = .FALSE..

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$. If `WANTZ` = .TRUE., $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge N$.

params.name: j1
params.reference: The index to the first block (A11, B11). $1 \le J_{1} \le N$.

params.name: n1
params.reference: The order of the first block (A11, B11). `N1 = 0`, 1 or 2.

params.name: n2
params.reference: The order of the second block (A22, B22). `N2 = 0`, 1 or 2.

params.name: lwork
params.reference: The dimension of the array `WORK`. $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max ( 1, N \, (N_{2}+N_{1}), (N_{2}+N_{1}) \, (N_{2}+N_{1}) \cdot 2 )$

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `=0`: Successful exit
-   `>0`: If `INFO = 1`, the transformed matrix (A, B) would be too far from generalized Schur form; the blocks are not swapped and (A, B) and (Q, Z) are unchanged. The problem of swapping is too ill-conditioned.
-   `<0`: If `INFO = -16`: `LWORK` is too small. Appropriate value for `LWORK` is returned in `WORK(1)`.

quickReturn.js: lwork < max( max( 1, N * (n1 + n2) ), (n1 + n2) * (n1 + n2) * 2 )

overrides.reason: The JS API takes J1 0-based (base.js indexes the diagonal with it directly, and dtgexc passes its 0-based block index).
